sv.title: Stort strömavbrott i Norrköping – runt 11 000 drabbade
sv.summary: Ett större strömavbrott drabbade Norrköping under torsdagsmorgonen. 10 963 av Eons kunder är just nu drabbade.

en.title: Major power outage in Norrköping – around 11,000 affected
en.summary: A major power outage hit Norrköping on Thursday morning. 10,963 of Eon's customers are currently affected.
